attention1.ptxt: Failure to use proper propeller shaft fasteners or to perform proper maintenance / repair of propeller shaft components can cause unsafe operating conditions.

item.ptxt: Replace propeller shaft fasteners only with fasteners having the same part number or their equivalent. Do not use replacement parts of lesser quality or substitute design.
Observe the specified torque value for each fastener to assure proper retention of components.
Never repair any propeller shaft part using heating, quenching, or straightening. Instead, replace the part with a new one.
